name: ha_snapshot
title: Inventory snapshot for Home Assistant
description: Read-only inventory of the connected Home Assistant instance: every entity (with current state and attributes), device, area, integration and config entry, plus the core version. Returned as compact JSON in the domusops.snapshot/0.1 format. detail=summary gives counts and topology only; standard (default) is grouped, templated and at least 10x smaller than the raw registries on a 500-entity reference instance (asserted in CI); full keeps every field, including those standard omits, in the same lossless encoding. Secrets and coordinates are always redacted. Every response reports its compression_ratio. Requires DOMUSOPS_HA_URL and DOMUSOPS_HA_TOKEN (administrator user).

detail.description: summary: counts and topology only. standard: compressed full inventory. full: every field, including those standard omits (escape hatch; larger).
